main_text.p: gnatum:idcirco adiecit 60 dies,vt Marriu·n cum præ-cedente Mercedonio retraheret ad locu naturalem, quo iusto interuallo abesset a bruma subsequenti. At quia Cæsar non præcise ab ipsa bruma, hoc est, ingrediIu iolis in Capricornum, qui contingebat die 1 Decembris, currente anno primo ante ordinationem Iulianam, ded ab octauo demum die subsequente, in quem noui unium incurrit, voluit epocham suam exordiri, præterea adiecit 7 dies: quiad 60 priores additi, summam intercalationis Iulianæ efficiunt 67 dierum. Quæ vtrecitius intelligantur, cogitetur, Cæsarem intercalalle iuos 67 dies post finem Decembris lunaris, ita vt posit 27 Septembris, currente anno primo ante ordinationem Iulianam, fingatur statim subsecutus fuisse December lunaris, qui defierit in 16 Octobris, labente anno eodem primo ante ordinationem Iulianam: itaq; a 27 Octobris, kal. Ianuarij lunares iterum fuissent inchoandi; sed animaduertit Cæsar hac ratione kal. Ianuarias lunares anticipaturas brumam 60 diebus, & præcedentes ante nouilunium a bruma proximum diebus 67: quare coactus est inserere 67 dies, quo kal. suas primas Ianuarias figeret in nouilunio proximo brumæ, quod incurrebat in mediam noctem, ineunte secundum Romanos die octauo post brumam. Hinc colligitur annum confusionis definentem 31 Decembris incurrisse in diem septimum a bruma: ordinationem vero ipsam annorum & mensium Iulianorum incurrisse in diem octauum post brumam, hoc est in octauum gradum Capri-corni.

page.notes: Scan is a fragment at the start: the first word is "gnatum", continuing from the previous page. Several words are doubtful because of the poor print and the scan: "Marriu·n" (possibly "Martium" or a dotted abbreviation), "ingrediIu iolis" (probably "ingredientis"; the scan is unclear), "ded ab octauo" (letters unclear), "intercalalle iuos" (probably "intercalasse"), "posit 27" (probably "posuit" or "possit", not clearly read), "itaq;", "sed animaduertit". The line "ineunte secundum Romanos" and the number "31" in "annum confusionis definentem 31" were read from a blurred scan. The word "Capri-corni" is broken across the last two lines and kept with its printed hyphen. Page number is read as "352" from the top left, with the s-like character uncertain.
